{{recipe}}

Stuffing a steak with blue cheese is a great replacement for a pan sauce or steak sauce.

== Ingredients ==

=== Butter sauce ===
* [[Cookbook:Butter|Butter]]
* [[Cookbook:Shallot|Shallots]], [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]]
* [[Cookbook:Garlic|Garlic]], [[Cookbook:Mincing|minced]]
* [[Cookbook:Brandy|Brandy]]
* [[Cookbook:Black Pepper|Black pepper]]

=== Tenderloin ===
* 1–1¼-pound [[Cookbook:Beef#Loin|tenderloin]] roast cut from the center of the whole tenderloin
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]]
* Freshly-ground [[Cookbook:Black Pepper|black pepper]]
* [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|Olive oil]]
* 5 [[Cookbook:Ounce|ounces]] crumbled [[Cookbook:Gorgonzola Cheese|Gorgonzola]] cheese
== Procedure ==

=== Butter sauce ===
# Melt butter in a pan.
# Add shallots and garlic, and cook until the shallots are translucent.
# Add brandy off the heat, and cook until the taste of alcohol disappears.
# Season to taste with black pepper.
# Keep warm.

=== Tenderloin ===
#Make a slit in the center of the roast, but not all the way through.
#[[Cookbook:Brush|Brush]] roast with olive oil and season liberally with kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper. Let sit at room temperature 30–60 minutes.
#Heat a cast-iron grill pan over high heat 5–7 minutes. Add roast and cook until browned and slightly charred on all sides.
#Move to a baking pan and fill the slit with cheese. Tie closed with kitchen twine and let rest 20 minutes while [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] heats to 325°F.
#Coat the outside of the roast with the prepared butter sauce.
#Insert a probe [[Cookbook:Thermometer|thermometer]] at a 45° angle into the center of the roast. Place the pan into the oven and cook until internal temperature reaches 135°F.
#Remove to a plate and cover with [[Cookbook:Aluminium Foil|aluminum foil]]. Let rest 15 minutes before untying and carving.

Make a slit in the center of the roast, but not all the way through.
Brush roast with olive oil and season liberally with kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper. Let sit at room temperature 30–60 minutes.
Heat a cast-iron grill pan over high heat 5–7 minutes. Add roast and cook until browned and slightly charred on all sides.
